title: Begin recovery activation: exact automatic replay with complete takeover and settlement barriers
outcome: After the foundation lands, eligible normal-operation begin-unknown automatically reconciles the retained exact begin and delivers its original head once through the existing bounded scheduler. Complete ownership and settlement barriers precede activation; saved old/new boot recovery remains separately held for slice B.
acceptance: R1: On the accepted foundation, an eligible normal-operation begin-unknown automatically replays its immutable exact grant/tokens/original begin key under validated stable producer authority and a valid current connection, without Resume. Applied begin returns its retained receipt; live issued grant begins at most once. A permanent lost-reply witness distinguishes one remote begin from one retained original-head provider handoff and prevents a second handoff.

R2: Activation uses the existing shared scheduler, unchanged2/5/10/20/30/60-second delays, at most20percent positive jitter, bind/circuit not-before times, call/dispatch budgets, one-head guard and aggregate four-slot cap. Timeout/unavailability retains the same unresolved key. Cap deferral charges neither attempt index nor first-held time. Preview names reconciliation, attempt and due time. Tests cover caps, delays, holds and positive eligible replay.

R3: Shared exact attempt authority extends through replay reservation, off-lock transport, result ACK and provider delivery settlement. Stop/Cancel/Resume/admission/bind/reset/revocation/replacement/removal and compensating checkpoint races join, defer or explicitly transfer ownership. Barrier witnesses before reservation, in flight and before local result/delivery commit prove no stale settlement, successor release, removed-head resurrection, operator-pause bypass or duplicate delivery. Remote Begin plus failed/ambiguous result ACK stays visibly held until exact valid reconciliation.

R4: Only a producer-attributed grant_expired result for the retained never-begun exact envelope permits fresh ordinary admission, with a different key only for that fresh grant after durable settlement. Every grant_scope_mismatch, including after status/resume expiry, remains held; missing grants, null/different status, stale identity and fresh evaluate are never negative proof or harmless probes. No fabricated restart checkpoint settles uncertainty.

R5: Activation covers normal-operation recovery only. New/legacy saved uncertainty remains fenced before competing boot, bind, restart-checkpoint, Resume and admission until separately verified slice B reconstructs it. Tests prove no boot wire action or provider handoff bypasses this boundary; healthy and operator controls remain covered. Closing-checkpoint recovery is not activated.

R6: docs describe enabled normal-operation replay, authority, ownership, settlement and temporary boot boundary. The holder declares/measures a separately concurred activation line guard before implementation. This child has its own passed maintained full gate/host Test record on the exact final input, independent read-only Codex/Claude pair without outstanding in-scope Medium+, filed remaining Lows and independent acceptance. Current w79 and parent receive their own final combined evidence/evaluation rather than inheriting child credit automatically.
